title: The Digital clock on the wall
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：digital　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 digital 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the shopkeeper wrote of ① a digital clock on the wall in the account, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so digital that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the shopkeeper, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the digital ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the digital clock on the wall that anybody there had ever seen, or so the account for July 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too digital to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the digital ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a digital copy of the photo, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as digital as the copy of the photo they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was digital or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was ⑦ something digital, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite digital; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the account kept the names of the digital ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, twice over, she wrote of another digital clock on the wall in the same account, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less digital than anybody had expected. ⑩ The digital copy of the photo that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the digital ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 数字（前置定语 a digital clock on the wall：1952 年掌柜在账本里记下的那件数字的钟）
B. adj. 数字／数码（两处加强说法：so digital that … 与 no less digital than …）
C. adj. 数字／数码（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 数字（表语 too digital to do：母亲觉得它太数字，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 数码（前置定语 a digital copy of the photo：叔叔把整件事称作一桩数码的电子版本）
F. adj. 数码（同级比较 as digital as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩照片的电子版本相比）
G. adj. 数码（后置定语 something digital：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 数码（受程度副词修饰 quite digital：那位买主的评价）

items.q: a digital clock on the wall
the digital clock on the wall that
a digital copy of the photo
The digital copy of the photo that

answers.why: digital 意为“数字”，1952 年掌柜在账本里记下的是“一件数字的钟”，此处作前置定语 a digital clock on the wall。
digital 意为“数字”，此处用 so digital that 结构，说它数字到铺子里没人敢靠近。
digital 意为“数字”，账本上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的数字墙上的钟，等于最高级的说法。
digital 意为“数字”，母亲认为这件东西“太数字了，谁也用不上”，too digital to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
digital 意为“数码”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩数码的电子版本”，此处作前置定语 a digital copy of the photo。
digital 意为“数码”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩照片的电子版本一样数码”，同级比较用 as digital as。
digital 意为“数码”，账本上那半行字要的是“数码的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something digital。
digital 意为“数码”，邻铺子来的那位买主认为这套计划“相当数码”，quite 修饰原级 digital。
digital 意为“数码”，no less digital than 表示“其数码不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之数码不亚于任何人的预料。
digital 意为“数码”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的数码电子版本”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，掌柜在账本里记下了一件数字的钟。（a digital clock on the wall）
它数字到铺子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so digital that …）
母亲觉得它太数字，谁也用不上。（too digital to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩数码的电子版本。（a digital copy of the photo）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩照片的电子版本一样数码。（as digital as …）
到了 1959 年，账本上只剩半行字：要的是一件数码的东西。（something digital）
answers: In 1952 the shopkeeper wrote of a digital clock on the wall in the account.
It was so digital that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too digital to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a digital copy of the photo.
He said nobody would call it as digital as the copy of the photo they had once had.
By 1959 the account asked for nothing but something digital.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 digital 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the shopkeeper wrote of a digital clock on the wall in the account, and nobody forgot it.
It was the digital clock on the wall that anybody there had ever seen, or so the account says.
My mother thought it too digital to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a digital copy of the photo, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next shop called the plan quite digital, and everybody laughed.
The digital ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
